title: Container Escape Plan
summary: Audit a set of deployment artifacts riddled with security misconfigurations.
briefing:
NebulaCorp's DevSecOps team recovered four deployment artifacts from a misconfigured CI/CD pipeline that was accidentally made public:

- Dockerfile.txt — the container image build instructions
- deployment.yaml — the Kubernetes deployment manifest
- pipeline.yml — the GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow
- env-staging.txt — a staging environment configuration file

Each file contains one or more serious security misconfigurations: hardcoded credentials, privileged containers, exposed host resources, and more.

A previous security auditor left an encoded summary of the most critical finding in one of the files. Find the Base64-encoded string that does not look like a normal configuration value, decode it, and submit the flag it contains.

The flag summarizes the three worst Kubernetes misconfigurations in the deployment manifest.
objectives: Review all four files for security misconfigurations
Find the Base64-encoded audit finding hidden in one of the files
Decode it to recover the flag

hints.title: Where to look
hints.text: One of the configuration files contains a comment with a Base64-encoded string. It looks like a long alphanumeric string ending in = signs.

hints.title: Which file
hints.text: The encoded finding is in the env-staging.txt file, in a comment line. Decode it with: echo "<string>" | base64 -d

artifacts.description: Docker build instructions for the API service.
